case: array of a domain over UUID
contract: Before the fix, PostgreSQL UUID-domain arrays were returned as Undecodable even though UUID[] is supported.

After the fix, NULL arrays, empty arrays, UUID elements and NULL elements remain distinct and can be rebound through the qualified domain-array cast with matching array_to_json and array_send oracles.
A schema-aware keyed edit preserves the domain-array type and sibling row; a value rejected by the domain CHECK returns SQLSTATE 23514 and leaves both rows unchanged.
